facts.fact: 他追问 Death 牌会不会真指死亡——比如「所爱之人的死」。
facts.anchor: Does it ever actually mean death, though? Say…the death of a loved one?

facts.fact: 他说出此行真正的原因：他的女朋友——这个词在她耳边单曲循环。
facts.anchor: ‘Cassie,’ he says, whipping his head back up. ‘I don’t know if I’m supposed to tell you this or not, but I’m here because of my girlfriend.’

facts.fact: 女友失踪经过：普通一天，他下班回家人不在，衣服都在、一切如他早上离家时，从此音讯全无。
facts.anchor: she wasn’t there when I got home from work. All her clothes were, and everything looked exactly the same as when I left her sleeping in bed that morning, but I don’t know what happened.

facts.fact: 她的第一反应不是职业关切而是窃喜：女友变成「前女友——不再 ex-ist」。
facts.anchor: my heart is clinging to the realisation that the girlfriend he previously mentioned is now technically an ex. As in no longer ex-ists.

facts.fact: 他报过警，警方说感情跑路很常见、无能为力。
facts.anchor: I went to the police and reported her missing – like you’re supposed to do, right? But they said people run off from their relationships all the time.

facts.fact: 他说胃里有个感觉：她出事了——还问「这叫直觉吧？」
facts.anchor: I have this feeling in the pit of my stomach that something bad has happened to her. Do you know what I mean? What would you call that? Intuition?

facts.fact: 脑内女声命令她别说，她偏要跳——「这是我唯一一次幸福的机会」。
facts.anchor: This is my one shot at happiness. It’s my time now, I know it.

facts.fact: 她当场宣布判决：She’s dead——你女朋友走了。
facts.anchor: ‘I’m sorry, Finlay, but I’m afraid you’re right. Your girlfriend is gone.’
